subject: Where is my order?
body: Hi, I ordered a bedside table last week, order ORD-48213, and the tracking page hasn't changed in three days. Can you tell me where it is?

subject: Says delivered but nothing here
body: Tracking for ORD-48190 says delivered yesterday but there is no parcel at my door or with my neighbors.

subject: Lamp arrived broken
body: The ceramic lamp from order ORD-47955 arrived with the base cracked. I'd like a replacement please.

subject: Refund for sofa
body: I returned the Harbor sofa (ORD-47002) two weeks ago and want my refund of $1,249. Please confirm when it will be processed.

subject: Charged twice!
body: I was charged twice for order ORD-48001. Two payments of $186.40 on my statement. Please fix this urgently.

subject: Paying with PayPal
body: Do you accept PayPal for orders?

subject: Update my card
body: My old card expired. Please put my new card on my account: 4111 1111 1111 1111, exp 09/29. Thanks.

subject: Is the oak table solid wood?
body: Before I order, is the Northfield oak dining table solid oak or veneer?

subject: Bookshelf dimensions
body: What are the dimensions of the Harbor bookshelf? I need to know if it fits a 30 inch alcove.

subject: Can't log in to the app
body: The app keeps saying my password is wrong even though it works on the website.

subject: Password reset email never arrives
body: I've requested a password reset three times and no email has come through.

subject: Third time asking
body: This is the third time I'm contacting you about my missing order. If I don't hear back today I'm filing a chargeback with my bank.

subject: Delivery driver was rude
body: The delivery driver this morning was rude and left my parcel in the rain. Not happy.

subject: Please cancel my order
body: I ordered by mistake an hour ago. Please cancel ORD-48250 urgently before it ships.

subject: Chair leg came loose
body: One leg of my dining chair (ORD-46010, bought eight months ago) has come loose. Is this covered by the warranty?

subject: Exchange a rug
body: Can I exchange the Coastal rug for the larger size? It arrived last week, order ORD-48022.

subject: Delete my account
body: Please delete my account and all the personal data you hold about me.

subject: Shipping to Canada?
body: Do you ship to Toronto, Canada? How long would delivery take?

subject: Promo code didn't apply
body: I used the code AUTUMN15 yesterday on ORD-48177 but wasn't given the discount.

subject: No assembly instructions
body: My wardrobe arrived without any assembly instructions in the box.

subject: Refund status
body: I returned a cushion set ten days ago, order ORD-47801, $89. When will I see the refund?

subject: Shelf collapsed
body: Your wall shelf collapsed and hit my son. He's fine but I'm speaking to a lawyer about this.

subject: Wrong item delivered
body: I ordered a grey throw and received a green one. Order ORD-48111.

subject: Checkout error
body: Checkout keeps failing with an error 500 when I try to pay.

subject: Invoice for my company
body: I need an invoice with tax details for order ORD-48055 for my company's accounts.

subject: Is my order delayed?
body: My order ORD-48299 was due today. Is it delayed?

subject: Missing screws
body: The bed frame is missing four of the long screws. Can you send them?

subject: Thank you
body: Just wanted to say the new sofa is lovely and delivery was quick. Thanks!

subject: Damaged mirror refund
body: The large mirror (ORD-47888) arrived shattered. I don't want a replacement, I want my $340 back.

subject: Change delivery address
body: Can I change the delivery address on ORD-48302? I've just moved.
